calculate_elastic_tensor: calculate elastic tensor and moduli for atomic structures using an ASE calculator
run_elasticity_batch: run elasticity calculations on a batch of structures split across multiple array jobs
convert_units_to_gpa: convert elastic tensor and modulus values from eV/Angstrom^3 to GPa units
write_elasticity_results: write elasticity calculation results to a compressed JSON file in the results directory
handle_elasticity_errors: handle exceptions during elasticity calculations and capture error messages with tracebacks
